text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Error on the confirmation year (2025-07 to 2026-06), 1 point = 1% of a substation's capacity, from one XGBoost model per substation. The chosen set was fixed on 2024-07 to 2025-06 and not changed afterwards. Dot: estimate over three fitting seeds. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months.'
text.tspan: Error on the confirmation year (2025-07 to 2026-06), 1 point = 1% of a substation's capacity, from one XGBoost model per substation.
The chosen set was fixed on 2024-07 to 2025-06 and not changed afterwards.
Dot: estimate over three fitting seeds. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months.
